notes.title: Demo Update is out!
notes.content:
[h1]Backrooms Stories Demo Update[/h1]

We're excited to announce a new update to the Backrooms Stories Demo! Here's what we've included:

[h2]Visual Improvements[/h2][list]    [*]Added a new background image for the main menu that better captures the eerie atmosphere of the Backrooms[/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]    [*]Fixed issues with looping ambient sounds in multiple endings that were continuing to play when returning to choice screens[/*]    [*]Added proper sound management to ensure a more immersive audio experience throughout the game[/*]    [*]Ensured consistent sound behavior across all ending sequences[/*][/list]
This update focuses on polishing the audio experience and enhancing the visual presentation of the game. Dive back into the Backrooms and experience these improvements for yourself!

Thank you for your continued support!
